drills.title: Closed JSON Schema
drills.prompt: Write a JSON Schema for an object {name: string, tokens: integer} that REJECTS extra properties. Valid JSON only. Object schemas must set additionalProperties to false.
drills.reveal: Object schemas that omit additionalProperties: false accept unknown keys. The evaluator is a closed door.

drills.title: Tool definition, closed parameters
drills.prompt: Write an OpenAI-style tool definition named grade_atom. parameters is a closed object schema. Required: atom_id (string), pass (boolean). additionalProperties must be false on the parameters object.
drills.reveal: A tool without a closed parameters schema is an injection surface. Name, required, additionalProperties: false.

drills.title: Required route fields
drills.prompt: Write a closed JSON Schema for a route row. Required: method, path, handler. method enum is GET and POST. No extra keys.
drills.reveal: required[] is the contract. enum is the closed set. additionalProperties: false is the latch.

drills.title: House rule: closed tool schemas
drills.prompt: Write the grader house-rule as JSON (not a schema): {rule, matcher, fail_if_missing, required_value}. rule is tool_schema_must_be_closed. matcher is additionalProperties. fail_if_missing is true. required_value is false.
drills.reveal: Tool schemas without additionalProperties: false fail. That is a house rule, not a vibe.

drills.title: Grade request schema
drills.prompt: Write a closed JSON Schema for POST /api/grade. Required: drill_id, answer. Optional: chicago_day (string). Reject extra properties.
drills.reveal: The grade endpoint consumes a closed request. Optional fields live in properties, not in required.

drills.title: No consumer register
drills.prompt: Write a SYSTEM prompt that steers a model to emit ONLY a JSON object {pass: boolean, failures: string[]}. No consumer register: do not write please, act as, or nice table. Contracts, not manners.
drills.reveal: please / act as / nice table is consumer register. It fails steering drills. Emit the contract.
good: SYSTEM: Emit only a JSON object with keys pass (boolean) and failures (array of string). Closed object. Empty answers fail. No consumer register.

drills.title: Contracts, not vibes
drills.prompt: Replace vibe instructions with a contract. Output JSON: {invariants: string[], grader, forbidden: string[]}. grader must be deterministic. forbidden must include vibes and consumer_register. Do not use please / act as / nice table.
drills.reveal: A deterministic grader is the product. Vibes are not a predicate.

drills.title: Token budget
drills.prompt: Write a prompt-steer contract as JSON: {max_tokens, completion, stop}. max_tokens must be 256. completion must be json. stop is an array including ```.
drills.reveal: Budget is a number. Completion format is a closed enum. Stop sequences cut the tail.

drills.title: System vs user
drills.prompt: Write a two-message transcript as a JSON array. Index 0 role=system with invariants. Index 1 role=user with payload only. System content must contain the word invariants. User content must contain payload.
drills.reveal: Invariants live in system. Payload lives in user. Mixing them is a steering leak.

drills.title: Token unit for the grader
drills.prompt: Write the token-budget house rule as JSON: {unit, count, fail_when, max}. unit is whitespace_split. count is tokens. fail_when is gt_max. max is 256.
drills.reveal: The grader splits on whitespace. Numbers, not feelings.

drills.title: Workers routes
drills.prompt: Write a JSON array of {method, path, handler} for the Murty worker. Must include GET /api/health, GET /api/drills, POST /api/grade. Do not add an inference route.
drills.reveal: Three routes. Health, drills, grade. No inference on the first-paint path.

drills.title: wrangler.jsonc assets
drills.prompt: Write the wrangler config as JSON (no comments): name murty-fidget, main src/index.js, assets.directory ./public, observability.enabled true, compatibility_date 2026-09-14.
drills.reveal: HUD is assets. Worker is main. First paint is a static file, not a worker round-trip.

drills.title: Cache headers
drills.prompt: Write Cache-Control lines for three paths. index.html: no-store. drills.json: public, max-age=60. POST /api/grade: no-store. Include the header name Cache-Control on each.
drills.reveal: HTML is no-store so the fidget does not lie about the clock. drills.json may cache briefly. Grade is never cached.
good:
GET /index.html
Cache-Control: no-store

GET /drills.json
Cache-Control: public, max-age=60

POST /api/grade
Cache-Control: no-store

drills.title: No first-paint fetch to LLM
drills.prompt: Write the first-paint law as JSON: {fetch_llm, pyodide, drills, worker_required}. fetch_llm false, pyodide false, drills static, worker_required false.
drills.reveal: First paint is HTML + CSS + JS + an inlined bootstrap drill. The worker is optional. No inference.

drills.title: PWA / service worker
drills.prompt: Write a service-worker install handler in JS. Cache name murty-v1. Precache /, /index.html, /app.js, /grader.js, /drills.json, /style.css. Use addEventListener('install', ...).
drills.reveal: The SW is a cache, not a brain. Precache the HUD. Never fetch a model on install.

drills.title: First-paint budget
drills.prompt: Write first-paint budget JSON: {max_ms, blocking_scripts, inference, pyodide}. max_ms is 100. blocking_scripts is 0. inference false. pyodide false.
drills.reveal: 100ms is the budget. Zero blocking scripts. Zero inference. Zero Pyodide.

drills.title: No Python runtime on first paint
drills.prompt: Write the runtime allowlist as JSON: {first_paint: [html, css, js], forbid: [pyodide, python, wasm-python]}.
drills.reveal: Jobsite Spanish does not boot a Python interpreter to say hola. Neither does Murty.

drills.title: Ctrl+Enter and streak invariant
drills.prompt: Write the HUD keybind + streak invariant as JSON: {run, reveal_increments_streak, streak_moves_on, timezone}. run is Ctrl+Enter. reveal_increments_streak is false. streak_moves_on is pass===true. timezone is America/Chicago.
drills.reveal: Ctrl+Enter runs assertions. Reveal does not increment streak. Streak is a Chicago calendar, not a dopamine counter.

drills.title: Broadcast must be explicit
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {op, shapes_must, fail_if, fix, assert}. op is broadcast. shapes_must is explicit. fail_if is silent_expand. fix is view_or_expand_as. assert must mention shape.
drills.reveal: Silent broadcast is a shape bug with a green loss. Expand on purpose or fail.

drills.title: no_grad leak
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. Inference tensors must not leak into the graph. JSON: {context, leak_if, train_step_must, eval_forward}. context is torch.no_grad. leak_if is require_grad=True. train_step_must is enable_grad. eval_forward must contain torch.no_grad.
drills.reveal: Eval under no_grad. Train under enable_grad. A leaked require_grad=True is a memory fire.

drills.title: train/eval mismatch
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. Dropout and BatchNorm must match the phase. JSON: {train, eval, fail_if, bn}. train is model.train(). eval is model.eval(). fail_if is dropout_on_at_eval. bn is running_stats_frozen_in_eval.
drills.reveal: model.eval() is not optional. Measuring dropout noise is not a metric.

drills.title: detach
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. When a tensor must leave the graph. JSON: {op, use, never, example}. op is detach. use is targets_and_metrics. never is parameters_path. example must contain detach.
drills.reveal: Log with loss.detach().item(). Never detach the parameter path you still need to train.

drills.title: In-place vs out-of-place
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {forbid, reason, use, ok}. forbid is an array including add_ and relu_. reason is autograd_version_counter. use is out_of_place. ok includes add and relu.
drills.reveal: In-place ops bump the version counter and break the graph. Prefer out-of-place.

drills.title: Autograd graph retain
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {backward_once, retain_graph_default, allow_when, second_backward}. backward_once true. retain_graph_default false. allow_when is two_heads_one_graph. second_backward must contain retain_graph.
drills.reveal: Default is one backward, graph freed. retain_graph=True is a special case, then free.

drills.title: AMP / GradScaler order
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {autocast, scaler, order}. autocast is torch.cuda.amp.autocast. scaler is GradScaler. order is the array [autocast_forward, scaler.scale(loss).backward(), scaler.step(opt), scaler.update()].
drills.reveal: Forward under autocast. Backward through scaler.scale. step, then update. Skip the scaler and you skip the unscale.

drills.title: DataParallel vs DDP device
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {prefer, avoid, device, init}. prefer is DistributedDataParallel. avoid is DataParallel. device is cuda:local_rank. init is init_process_group.
drills.reveal: DataParallel scatters from cuda:0 and lies about device. DDP binds cuda:local_rank after init_process_group.

drills.title: Retry budget
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {max_retries, backoff_ms, retry_on, no_retry_on}. max_retries is 3. backoff_ms is [200, 800, 2000]. retry_on includes timeout and 429. no_retry_on includes 400 and schema_fail.
drills.reveal: Retry is a budget, not hope. Schema failures and 400s do not get another throw.

drills.title: Tool-arg injection
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. Tool args are untrusted. JSON: {parse, additionalProperties, reject, never_concat}. parse is json_schema. additionalProperties is false. reject includes path_traversal. never_concat is untrusted_observation_into_argv.
drills.reveal: Validate against a closed schema before the call. Never concatenate an observation into argv.

drills.title: Eval harness
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {gold, metric, split, n, forbid}. gold is frozen. metric is exact_match. split is held_out. n is 34. forbid is train_on_test.
drills.reveal: 34 frozen golds. exact_match. held_out. Training on the test set is not intelligence.

drills.title: Timeout vs retry
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. Timeout caps retry. JSON: {timeout_ms, retry_budget, xor, clock, rule}. timeout_ms is 8000. retry_budget is 3. xor is do not retry after deadline. clock is monotonic. rule is timeout_caps_retry.
drills.reveal: A retry after the deadline is a new request pretending to be the old one. Monotonic clock. XOR.

drills.title: Idempotency key
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. Mutating tool calls need an idempotency key. JSON: {header, key, replay, store}. header is Idempotency-Key. key is hash(drill_id+attempt_scope). replay is same_key_same_effect. store is ledger_only_on_pass.
drills.reveal: Same key, same effect. Ledger writes only on pass. Retries must not double-mutate.

drills.title: Schema before call
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {order, additionalProperties, skip_call_on}. order is [load_tool_schema, validate_args, call]. additionalProperties is false. skip_call_on is schema_fail.
drills.reveal: Load schema, validate args, then call. Schema fail skips the call. additionalProperties: false.

drills.title: Observation vs thought
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {thought, observation, never, format}. thought is private. observation is tool_result_only. never is tool_result_inside_thought_unlabeled. format must contain Observation.
drills.reveal: Thought is private. Observation is the tool result, labeled. Unlabeled tool text inside thought is a lie.

drills.title: Stop condition
drills.prompt: WRITE THE CONTRACT. JSON: {stop_when, max_steps, no_infinite}. stop_when includes pass===true, budget_exhausted, stop_token. max_steps is 8. no_infinite is true.
drills.reveal: Stop on pass, budget, or stop_token. max_steps 8. Infinite loops are not tenacity.
